name: 喜马拉雅山脉
author: 山脉 · 亚洲
core: 世界屋脊，拥有多座 8000 米级高峰；是长江、恒河、印度河等亚洲大河的发源地。
coreEn: The roof of the world, home to several 8000m peaks; source of the Yangtze, Ganges, Indus and more.
influence: 塑造南亚季风与下游数十亿人的水安全；冰川退缩是全球关注的信号。
influenceEn: Shapes the South Asian monsoon and water security for billions downstream; glacial retreat is a global alarm.

name: 长江
author: 河流 · 亚洲
core: 亚洲第一长河，自西向东贯通中国腹地，是航运、水电与灌溉的命脉。
coreEn: Asia's longest river, running west-to-east through China's heartland — a lifeline for shipping, hydropower and irrigation.
influence: 支撑长三角经济与全国粮食安全；调水与生态调度影响大半个中国。
influenceEn: Underpins the Yangtze Delta economy and national food security; diversions and ecology affect half of China.

name: 恒河
author: 河流 · 亚洲
core: 发源于喜马拉雅，流经印度腹地，被尊为圣河；也是数亿人的饮用水与农田水源。
coreEn: Born in the Himalaya, crossing India's heartland, revered as sacred and vital to hundreds of millions.
influence: 塑造北印度文明与农业；污染与流量波动是重大公共议题。
influenceEn: Shaped North Indian civilization and farming; pollution and flow swings are major public issues.

name: 印度河
author: 河流 · 亚洲
core: 发端于青藏高原，经克什米尔入巴基斯坦，是巴基斯坦农业与文明的母亲河。
coreEn: Rises on the Tibetan Plateau, enters Pakistan via Kashmir, and is the mother river of its agriculture and civilization.
influence: 支撑巴基斯坦粮仓；上游冰川与跨境分配牵动区域稳定。
influenceEn: Sustains Pakistan's breadbasket; upstream glaciers and sharing shape regional stability.

name: 亚马逊河
author: 河流 · 南美洲
core: 流量与流域面积均居世界第一，串起地球最大的热带雨林。
coreEn: The world's largest by discharge and basin, threading the planet's biggest rainforest.
influence: 在全球水循环与碳平衡中举足轻重；毁林威胁其自身雨林造雨能力。
influenceEn: Pivotal in global water and carbon cycles; deforestation threatens the forest's own rain-making.

name: 尼罗河
author: 河流 · 非洲
era: 维多利亚湖—埃及—地中海
core: 世界第一长河，穿非洲干旱带而过，几乎以一己之力哺育了古埃及文明。
coreEn: The world's longest river, crossing Africa's arid belt and single-handedly nurturing ancient Egypt.
influence: 文明与灌溉之源；上游开发与气候共同决定下游水安全。
influenceEn: Source of civilization and irrigation; upstream development and climate decide downstream water security.

name: 维多利亚湖
author: 湖泊 · 非洲
core: 非洲最大湖泊、尼罗河主要源头；渔业与淡水支撑数千万人生计。
coreEn: Africa's largest lake and a main source of the Nile; its fisheries and water sustain tens of millions.
influence: 区域淡水与粮食命脉；入侵物种与污染是主要威胁。
influenceEn: A regional lifeline of water and food; invasive species and pollution are key threats.

name: 落基山脉
author: 山脉 · 北美洲
core: 纵贯北美西部的脊梁，分水岭与冰川水源滋养大平原与西岸城市。
coreEn: The spine of western North America; its divide and glacial waters feed the Great Plains and coastal cities.
influence: 调控北美水与气候、承载旅游与生态；积雪变化影响下游用水。
influenceEn: Regulates North American water and climate and hosts tourism and ecology; snowpack swings affect downstream use.

name: 密西西比河
author: 河流 · 北美洲
core: 北美最长水系主干，串起大平原粮仓与众多工业城市，是美国的航运大动脉。
coreEn: Trunk of North America's longest system, linking the Great Plains breadbasket and industrial cities — a shipping artery.
influence: 农业出口与工业运输基石；堤坝与改道改变河口生态。
influenceEn: Cornerstone of farm exports and industrial transport; levees and diversions reshape the delta ecology.

name: 安第斯山脉
author: 山脉 · 南美洲
eraEn: West coast of South America (7 countries)
core: 世界最长山脉，沿太平洋东缘延展，分隔海岸沙漠与亚马逊，孕育印加文明。
coreEn: The world's longest range, edging the Pacific and separating coastal deserts from the Amazon; cradle of the Inca.
influence: 控制南美气候与径流；矿产（铜、锂）与高山农业意义重大。
influenceEn: Controls South American climate and runoff; minerals (copper, lithium) and highland farming matter globally.

name: 大堡礁
author: 珊瑚礁 · 大洋洲
core: 地球最大的活体结构，由数十亿珊瑚虫构筑，是生物多样性极高的海洋生态系统。
coreEn: The largest living structure on Earth, built by billions of polyps — a hyper-diverse marine ecosystem.
influence: 护佑海岸、支撑渔业与旅游；海水升温正引发大规模白化。
influenceEn: Shelters coasts, supports fisheries and tourism; warming seas drive mass bleaching.

name: 贝加尔湖
author: 湖泊 · 亚洲
core: 世界最深的淡水湖，蓄水占全球地表淡水约两成，特有物种众多。
coreEn: The deepest lake on Earth, holding about a fifth of the planet's surface freshwater, with many endemic species.
influence: 全球淡水战略储备与气候研究关键站点；污染与开发需谨慎。
influenceEn: A strategic global freshwater reserve and climate research site; pollution and development need care.

name: 苏伊士运河
author: 人工水道 · 非洲—亚洲交界
core: 连通地中海与红海、避免绕行好望角的航运捷径，是全球经济的大动脉之一。
coreEn: Links the Mediterranean and Red Sea, sparing the Cape route — one of the world economy's great arteries.
influence: 左右亚欧货运成本与能源运输；堵塞即冲击全球供应链。
influenceEn: Sets Asia–Europe freight and energy costs; a blockage jolts global supply chains.
